name: caregiver-career-transition-plan
title_zh: 照护者重返职场，先画能力地图再投简历
tagline_zh: 带娃带老人间隙里想找工作，最怕计划赶不上照护突发。它把碎片时间、可迁移技能和备选照护人一起排进路线图，简历不掺水。
tagline_en: Job hunting while caring for kids or elders? Plans collapse when care duties spike. This maps your real free.
desc_en: Use when a single parent or primary caregiver wants low-pressure help with career exploration, returning to work, changing roles, learning, job-search materials, or onboarding while balancing real care and time constraints. It integrates a capacity map, skills evidence, flexible-role search, small learning steps, truthful materials, and backup-care readiness. Do not submit applications, contact em
why_zh: 不催你投简历，先按真实照护时段生成能力证据链，再筛弹性角色。每一步都留备选照护预案。
why_en: It refuses to rush you into applications. Instead, it builds evidence from your actual care schedule, matches flexible roles.
limit_zh: 只做规划与材料生成，不代投简历、不联系雇主。需要你先录入照护时段与技能清单；若照护安排每周变动超三次，路线图会频繁重排。
limit_en: Planning and material prep only—no job submissions or employer contact. Requires your care schedule and skill list upfront; if care shifts >3x.
title_en: Caregiver career re-entry: map capacity first, then apply
